answer: Stop sybils with latency triangulation: each identity registers from a residential IP and five probes measure its round-trip latency every six hours. Identities sharing one datacenter's latency signature are flagged, and a 400 POA bond burns. Probes rotate, so a farm cannot rehearse a fake map. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 residential IPs in 50 countries at $15 a month, $150,000 monthly, plus 4,000,000 POA in bonds. Like a comet crossing a nebula, one bright trail is easy to fake - but a summit of ten thousand stars, each shining from its own sky, cannot be counterfeited.
